reservation.purpose: Reserve layout space only when a future ad slot is explicitly inserted.

rules: Do not insert the boundary on excluded routes.
Do not load advertising runtime code as part of this contract.
Do not use the boundary as a substitute for publisher-specific Google configuration.
Keep publisher content visually and semantically primary.
Do not place the boundary where it can be mistaken for navigation, controls, downloads, or site content.
Only an explicitly inserted future slot may reserve this space; do not add empty placeholders to pages before activation.
